get.summary:
`GET /v1/admin/overnight` - the reconcile queue feed. Mismatches are
transient (outbox events feed the ops queue); the wall shows the
opening-balance table for today with position-snapshot deltas.
Spec wrapper for the inline health closure (binary has no named fn).

post.summary:
Session close (the Cron proxy-back target): persist all
positions/resumes/summaries + tomorrow's opening balances.

get.summary:
The desk board (manager scope): today's trader summary rows from the
DB (source of truth - the persist pass).
